entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It doesn't work.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate. The thing is garbage.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. Sometimes a quick reset or a firmware update can resolve sensor inaccuracies. If you have a few minutes, I can walk you through—
No. I don't have time for that. I'm not your IT department. I just want money back for the faulty product you sold me. I want a refund.
Okay, I understand. You're not interested in troubleshooting and would prefer to proceed with a return. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your name or order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 16th. Let me just review the return policy for you.
Alright, I've checked our policy here. It looks like items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.

Since you received it 44 days ago, you're well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process that return for you. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. As soon as our warehouse receives the band, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Perfect. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
